name: Fireworks AI
h1: Fireworks AI ARR: $1B+ and 5x in a Year.
intro: Fireworks AI turned serving open-source models into a $1B+ annualized revenue run rate — up 5x in a year — and closed a $1.5B Series D at $17.5B to prove inference is its own market. Every reported ARR, funding and token-volume number is collected below, each traced back to a public source.

modelTitle: How 40 Trillion Daily Tokens Turn Into Revenue.
modelParagraphs: Fireworks runs an inference cloud: per-token serverless APIs for open and custom models, plus dedicated capacity and fine-tuning for enterprises that want optimized private deployments. The wedge is cost and speed — serving open models on Fireworks' optimized stack undercuts closed frontier-model APIs, and the volume shows it: from 10T+ tokens per day at the Series C to more than 40 trillion per day at $1B+ annualized revenue in July 2026.

The next act is 'specialized intelligence' — custom enterprise models built on Fireworks' infrastructure, with planned distribution through Microsoft Foundry and Azure. The capital follows the revenue curve: a $250M Series C at $4B (~$280M ARR) was followed by a $1.505B Series D at $17.5B led by Atreides Management, Index Ventures and TCV, with NVIDIA staying on — roughly a 4.4x valuation jump in about a year as run rate grew ~5x.

faqs.q: What Is Fireworks AI's ARR in 2026?
faqs.a: Fireworks AI surpassed $1 billion in annualized revenue run rate in July 2026, disclosed alongside its $1.505B Series D. That is up roughly 5x year over year, with Sacra having estimated ~$800M ARR in May 2026 and ~$305M at the end of 2025.

faqs.q: How Fast Is Fireworks AI Growing?
faqs.a: About 5x year over year as of July 2026. Token volume tells the same story: from 10T+ tokens served per day at the Series C (~$280M ARR) to more than 40 trillion per day at the $1B+ run rate.

$17.5 billion at the July 2026 Series D — $1.505 billion raised, led by Atreides Management, Index Ventures and TCV, with NVIDIA participating. That is a ~4.4x jump from the $4B Series C valuation roughly a year earlier.

faqs.q: How Does Fireworks AI Make Money?
faqs.a: Per-token serverless inference APIs for open and custom models, dedicated optimized capacity for enterprise workloads, and fine-tuning services. It is expanding into custom 'specialized intelligence' enterprise models with planned availability via Microsoft Foundry and Azure.

faqs.q: How Does Fireworks Compare to Together AI and Baseten?
faqs.a: All three sell AI inference, at different scales: Fireworks at $1B+ annualized ($17.5B valuation), Together AI at ~$1B revenue on $1.15B bookings ($8.3B), and Baseten at ~$600M ARR ($13B). Fireworks differentiates on inference optimization for open models and its NVIDIA-backed serving stack.
